lists.author: Hellowhosthat
lists.title: Suggested on Fight Lab: Hellowhosthat on Sherdog forums
lists.background:
Obviously this guy would have been hyped much earlier but since the 4th fight of his career he's been with ACA. After going 6-0 under a quality banner like that he decided to leave and pursue the UFC dream with his first step being a bit of a drop in competition but still picking up a regional title and an easy win.

He's unbelievably talented both standing and on the ground and in particular the way he showed Alexsandro Praia the right then blasted him with the left in ACA stands out as a kid who not only hits hard and quickly but is also intelligent in the way he sets things up.

Ideally the UFC will just sign him straight away but he might have to have a fight or two in a Fight Pass promotion like UAE Warriors to truly get on the radar but at 22 and already in double digit wins, time is on his side.

lists.author: Hellowhosthat
lists.title: Suggested on Fight Lab: Hellowhosthat on Sherdog forums
lists.background: For some reason this guy is fighting some poor regional US heavyweights in Peak at the moment. It's pretty cruel to be honest. He's pretty quick and explosive for a heavyweight, can throw high kicks, hits really fucking hard with the hands and is an excellent wrestler with great ground and pound too. It kind of looks like an adult going into a primary school playground and fighting the kids, I get he's only 3-0 but I think they need to book this guy on the Contender Series just to keep people safe.
